name: Ward L. Lambert Fieldhouse and Gymnasium
changes: Replaced the prior elliptical track with a six-lane stadium-shaped loop whose modeled lane-one centerline is 200 m by construction: two 45 m straights plus two semicircles with derived radius 17.507 m.
Added seven continuous track boundary markings and a cross-track finish marking.
Replaced four flat bleacher slabs with eight stepped seating rows along both long sides; individual charcoal seats and restrained gold blocks are grouped into low object-count meshes.
Added a schematic competition infield, ceiling light bars, and revised the roof finish with subtle longitudinal seam details and reduced emission.
Removed an unsupported full-footprint intermediate floor plate that occluded the interior track; retained the official GIS footprint and exterior structure.
Added a separate open-roof review camera and produced exterior and interior review renders. Preview-only hide states are not saved to the building source.
